notes.title: The Holiday Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309499/26f9b3b115b84dc47b3c386f4fd134fd1bbd437f.png[/img]
[h2]New Episode: Frozen Peaks[/h2][list]    [*]8 New Levels![/*]    [*]1 New Boss[/*]    [*]2 New Cosmetics[/*]    [*]New Enemy: Snowman[/*]    [*]New Enemy: Nutcracker[/*][/list][h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2][list]    [*]Score ranking system updated.[/*][/list][h2]Enemy Changes[/h2][h3]Sniper:[/h3][list]    [*]The laser now changes color when the sniper fires a round.[/*][/list][h3]Woodsman:[/h3][list]    [*]Tweaked parry animation.[/*]    [*]Fixed a bug preventing him from hurting enemies.[/*]    [*]Complete rework to his charge mechanic:        [list]            [*]You can now dodge his swing.[/*]            [*]He will no longer reflect projectiles unless he is charging.[/*]            [*]He can no longer hit you from behind.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]Power-up Changes[/h2][h3]Bunny Ears:[/h3][list]    [*]Reset time increased from 0.5 to 1.3 seconds.[/*]    [*]Cooldown timer increased from 0.3 to 0.5 seconds.[/*][/list][h2]Hero Changes[/h2][h3]Blue:[/h3][list]    [*]Blue is now affected by Haste.[/*]    [*]Reflected projectiles now deal 5% of the original owner’s health as damage.        [list]            [*](This improves Blue’s ability to take down bosses.)[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]UI Changes[/h2][list]    [*]Player outlines added.[/*]    [*]Enemy outlines added.[/*]    [*]Pickup outlines added.[/*]    [*]Settings menu now closes during gameplay.[/*]    [*]Gameplay tab in the settings menu reorganized.[/*][/list][h2]Boss Changes[/h2][list]    [*]Zepharius now behaves differently when playing as Blue.[/*][/list][h2]Map Changes[/h2][list]    [*][b]E1M12:[/b] Arrow now points correctly.[/*]    [*][b]E2M21:[/b] Added an extra platform.[/*]    [*][b]E3M3:[/b] Added some extra goodies.[/*]    [*][b]E3M21:[/b] Added a guiding sign (sorry about that!).[/*]    [*][b]E3M23:[/b] Fixed some graphical errors.[/*]    [*][b]E4M7:[/b] Added some extra goodies.[/*]    [*][b]E4M17:[/b] Adjusted the rising platform near the exit.[/*]    [*][b]E4M19:[/b] Changes made to the infamous platform.[/*]    [*][b]E4M22:[/b] Added a Blue-exclusive power-up.[/*]    [*]Lasers now hurt enemies.[/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]    [*]Fixed a bug in level select that loaded the incorrect save file.[/*]    [*]Fixed a bug causing episodes to unlock and lock incorrectly.[/*]    [*]Fixed a bug where music restarted on retry or level change.[/*]    [*]Fixed a bug where the cosmetics tab would load incorrectly for save files with Blue.[/*]    [*]Fixed an issue where Bunny Ears triggered excessively on sloped floors.[/*]    [*]Fixed an oversight where you always received max arrows.[/*]    [*]Boss music no longer restarts on death.[/*][/list][h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list]    [*]Added an Easter egg.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309499/bf35eeb21012b72540bd4e62f6e44cf770e18410.png[/img]
